verified: Fast Company's investigation, which profiled the backgrounds of 130 employees, establishes that Prometheus is Jeff Bezos' AI startup, has raised $18B, and employs roughly 250 people recruited from aerospace, biotech, defense and other fields, Fast Company reported.
unconfirmed: The claim that Prometheus is building an "end-to-end agentic AI engineering system" rests on unnamed sources, and the company has not publicly described the system's capabilities, customers or a release date. Funding figures also differ across reports: earlier coverage described a $12B Series B at a $41B valuation, and it is unclear whether Fast Company's $18B refers to total capital raised or a later round.

verified: Fast Company 记者 Rebecca Heilweil 的独家调查（核查了 130 名 Prometheus 员工的背景）报道称，贝索斯支持的这家 AI 初创公司目前约有 250 名员工、累计融资 180 亿美元，并从航空航天、生物技术、国防等领域招人；该报道标题同时给出 410 亿美元估值。
unconfirmed: “正在构建端到端智能体（agentic）AI 工程系统”仅为报道援引的匿名消息源说法，公司未公开产品形态、技术细节、时间表或客户。融资口径也需注意：其他报道称 Prometheus 完成 120 亿美元 B 轮融资、估值 410 亿美元，180 亿美元是累计融资额还是另有构成、其中多少为已到账股权资金，现有报道均未说明；此外没有任何独立测试或性能数据。

titles.en: Bezos-backed Prometheus has raised $18B and is reportedly building an agentic AI engineering system
titles.zh: 贝索斯 AI 初创 Prometheus 据报融资 180 亿美元并开发智能体工程系统
